messages:
Olivia (AE): Need a tight POC onboarding checklist for ACME: hosted API keys, optional Dedicated reserve for spikes, and a VPC trial. Two-week timeline. Who owns each step?
Sam (SE): I can run infra. Minimal runbook: create scoped POC API key (14d TTL), open ops ticket for small Dedicated commit with auto-release, configure routing prefer Dedicated -> Hosted fallback, attach 10-prompt smoke test.
Raj (Solutions): I'll draft the brief security answers: SSO (SAML), KMS/BYOK support, audit logs, data retention. Flag PHI/PII — if yes, escalate to Private deployment.
Lee (Eng): Key policy: prefer ephemeral scoped keys. If long-lived required, require IP allowlist + rotation. For Dedicated, note GPU type and qps target.
Maria (Product): Pricing: Hosted-only = usage; Hosted+Dedicated adds pro-rated reserved fee. I need qps + avg prompt to give sticker.
Sam (SE): Smoke test curl example to give customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"input":"Summarize: Quick onboarding test","model":"redwood-1"}'
```
Olivia (AE): Network/VPC checklist?
Raj (Solutions): Request customer CIDR, contact engineer, confirm outbound 443, decide on static egress for allowlist, exchange SAML metadata if SSO wanted.
Sam (SE): I'll file ops ticket now: title `OPS: POC - ACME - Dedicated req - 1848009999`. Will attach SJQ and set auto-release 14 days.
eng-oncall-bot: Ticket POC-1848009999 created and assigned to infra-team.
Olivia (AE): Great. Next: Sam opens ticket, Raj posts security answers, Maria sends pricing estimate, Olivia collects IdP metadata if applicable. Confirm?
Sam (SE): Confirmed.
Raj (Solutions): Confirmed, posting answers today.
Maria (Product): Confirmed, sending numbers after qps estimate.
Olivia (AE): Thanks team :rocket:
